in_hebrew.name: גמינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'gam' meaning 'twin' or 'double', this name is derived from the root 'gym' which signifies the idea of being 'double' or 'duplicate'.

in_greek.name: Γεμίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'geminos' meaning 'twin' or 'double', this name is derived from the root 'gem' which signifies the idea of being 'identical' or 'similar'. It can also be used to refer to a sister due to the close relationship and similarity between siblings.

in_latin.name: Gemina
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'geminus' meaning 'twin' or 'double', this name is derived from the root 'gem' which signifies the idea of being 'identical' or 'similar'. It can also be used to refer to a pair or duo in various contexts.
